A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ENGINE study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable matching across revisions.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments on nine benchmarks, component ablations, sensitivity analyses, and supplementary experiments with multiple seeds.

after.justification: v2 retains original benchmark results, ablations, sensitivity analyses, and supplementary experiments, including the five-seed analysis.

M1.justification: Section 4.1 newly mentions matching visual features to prototypes to assist recognition. However, the losses and final prediction equation remain unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish whether this introduces a procedure or documents existing behavior. The remaining method components are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same nine datasets: Aircraft, CIFAR100, Cars, ImageNet-R, CUB, UCF, SUN, Food, and ObjectNet. The tasks and supplementary test scenarios remain unchanged; removing the RanPAC comparison does not remove ImageNet-R coverage.

E2.justification: v2 removes Appendix I.6 and Table 5, eliminating the evaluated RanPAC comparator on ImageNet-R B0 Inc20 and B100 Inc20. RanPAC remains cited in related work. Comparator membership in the retained experiments is unchanged.

E3.justification: Retained experiments use the same class subsets, incremental splits, CLIP initialization, training schedule, batch size, hyperparameters, and average/last accuracy metrics. No revised evaluation protocol or new experimental design is reported.

E4.justification: The component ablation, parameter sensitivity, feature visualizations, reranking examples, runtime analysis, and alternative backbone-weight and LLM analyses are retained unchanged. The deleted RanPAC table is a benchmark comparison rather than an ablation or robustness analysis.

E5.justification: Both Appendix I.1 sections report the same five class-order seeds, 1993–1997, and the same average-performance and variability presentation in Figure 7. No run-count, uncertainty-reporting, or statistical-testing practice changes.

E6.justification: The RanPAC results in v1 Table 5 disappear: average/last accuracy of 85.61/79.68 on ImageNet-R B0 Inc20 and 81.54/79.27 on B100 Inc20. Tables 1–4 and the retained plots preserve their results. This is removal of comparative evidence, not a same-setting performance change.

T1.justification: The problem formulation and Equations 1–15 are mathematically unchanged, as are the appendix's reparameterization and computational-count arguments. No formal assumptions, proofs, or theoretical results are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: dual-branch external knowledge injection, inference-time reranking, and state-of-the-art incremental classification performance. Shortened wording does not materially change these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning feature alignment, forgetting, external knowledge, and reranking remain unchanged. Both versions retain the limitation that GPT-4 may fail to generalize to particular tasks and suggest alternative knowledge sources.

D1.justification: The advertised code location changes from RenaissCode/ENGINE to LAMDA-CL/ICCV25-ENGINE. v2 adds the brief prototype-matching disclosure and removes the RanPAC implementation paragraph. The retained hardware, hyperparameters, training details, and inference-precomputation instructions are unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds three works: dual-balance collaborative experts, training-free CLIP adaptation, and cross-modal neighbor representations, cited as references 36, 67, and 74. These modestly extend the context without changing the overall research positioning; RanPAC remains cited despite its removed evaluation.

P1.justification: v2 makes local grammatical corrections and wording reductions, adds a corresponding-author note and acknowledgments, and removes Appendix I.6. The overall narrative and section hierarchy remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: Table 5 is removed, Table 2 moves within page 6 and receives a shorter caption, and several appendix figures move as text reflows. Existing figure content, plot designs, legends, and remaining table structures are preserved.

improvement.justification: v2 removes a useful comparison against a close competitor: v1 Table 5 reports RanPAC at 79.68% versus ENGINE at 80.37% final accuracy on ImageNet-R B0 Inc20. This narrows the evidence available to assess the retained superiority claims. The limited documentation, citation, and language refinements do not outweigh that loss, although the main experiments and analyses remain intact.
